cv_runs.purpose: Detect full circles and arcs on the whole figure as a first pass.
Detect straight segments on the whole figure.
Install vertex labels by glyph extraction, template matching and Hungarian binding.

finish.summary: Reconstructed the triangle ABC figure as compilable standalone TikZ (version 4, best version, critic score 0.95, must_repair=false). It contains solid AB, AC, BC, GC, GD and dashed AE and BH through G, with labels A, B, C, D, E, G, H. No right-angle marks were claimed or drawn, since none were verified.
